PREREGISTERED_FALSIFIER.the_sharper_restriction_if_the_row_wants: torch.autograd.grad(outputs=z_out, grad_outputs=cot_z, inputs=trunk_params) on the ORIGINAL graph, compared against the banked g_zonly (squared norm 0.4071279988965891). PREREGISTERED_FALSIFIER.the_caveat_that_keeps_it_honest: dL/dz_in from the real backward is the TOTAL over every consumer of z_in while the injected one is the stack's contribution alone, so an ordinary second consumer separates them for a reason that is not a defect. gB -- the parameter gradients, which no consumer of z_in can touch -- is the reading; dz_in is the cheap tell.
